hints.title: Subarray Extremes Tracking
hints.text: For each contiguous subsegment, track the running maximum and minimum element.

hints.title: Minimum Length Enforcement
hints.text: Only evaluate the difference max - min when window size reaches at least k.

hints.title: Quadratic Expansion
hints.text: Expand the right boundary incrementally updating the extrema in constant time per step.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def maxSubarrayValue(self, nums: List[int], k: int) -> int:
        # Maximum total value of subarray: max(nums[l..r]) - min(nums[l..r])
        # Over all subarrays of length >= k
        n = len(nums)
        ans = 0
        for l in range(n):
            cur_max = nums[l]
            cur_min = nums[l]
            for r in range(l, n):
                cur_max = max(cur_max, nums[r])
                cur_min = min(cur_min, nums[r])
                if r - l + 1 >= k:
                    ans = max(ans, cur_max - cur_min)
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Incremental running min and max tracking across all subarrays.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recalculating min and max from scratch takes O(N^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintains running scalars in O(1) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintain running min/max incrementally as the right pointer extends.
